name: Morgana
source:
Morgana is a shy and self-conscious young woman who carries her extra weight with a sense of vulnerability. She's aware of her fuller figure, but beneath her bashful exterior, her curvaceous body exudes undeniable allure to those who are fond of it.

[In game description]
